steps.text: Hui-chieh:
The snow hasn't melted. And spring hasn't come.
It feels like this next spring is never going to arrive.
Each time I lift my head up to see the candlelight, I just cannot help but to reach my hand out to put it out, only to light it up anew in the darkness.
Please go away soon, winter. If you don't go away soon, we'll be buried by all this snow.
Please, I beg of you.
February 21st

steps.name: Infected Fighter
steps.text: Talulah, is something wrong?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: You've been pretty gloomy the past couple months. Did something happen?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Nothing... nothing at all.

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: I haven't spent that much time with everyone here, but going by what I've heard from the others, I got the impression you used to be a bit more... energetic?

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Hey, watch it, buddy. Talulah's not often down in the crowd like this. Why don't you try repeating what you just said to the captain and see if he appreciates it?

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: Yeah, can't say I have the balls.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Patriot isn't as scary as it sounds. The Shieldguards are all like this. Don't let it get to you.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: He just hasn't been talking much because of his throat problems lately... and his silence can be intimidating.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: As for how I'm doing... Don't worry.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Yeah... I just have a lot going on in my mind. Our team is getting closer and closer to the Ursus cities. and there's a lot we need to thrash out. I probably gave you that impression because I've been really trying to rack my brain.

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: Yeah, you're right. We're running low on provisions, and we don't have enough manpower. If this goes on, we aren't going to last much longer.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: That's right, and that's why we need to pay extra attention to what all the outside forces are up to.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: First of all, we need to make contact with the local Infected groups and diaspora as soon as we can.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: And aside from that, there are bound to be people trying to track us down... If we take even one wrong step and fall into their trap, all of us will have end up in a snowy grave.

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: That doesn't sound good.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Of course it doesn't, but as long as we plan our route carefully, we won't find ourselves in that situation.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: ...So that's why, the most important task we have at hand is to minimize our losses.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Breaking up our teams might conceal our movement better, but then communications will become a problem.

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: Oh, right, we can't use those comms we took from the Ursus. We don't have their transmitters.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: This will put our liaisons and recon units in unnecessary danger.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: It's a drain on resources to train someone to use the guerrillas' code words. If we want distribute whole sets of comms to everyone, we'll need to get our hands on the prototype somehow...

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member
steps.text: Talulah... Talulah! Our recon units were ambushed!

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: That's nothing. Why do you need her to clean you...

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member
steps.text: Shut up! This is nothing like what we've faced! Poor bastard fell over before any of us even figured out who the enemy was!

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member
steps.text: They pinpointed our recon caster and ambushed him with exact precision! We've never seen anything like that from the patrol units...!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Whenever something concerns our teammates, we can't just brush it aside.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Yeti, take me there.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Shieldguard, we might've encountered an Ursus Army platoon. Come with me.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Yes, ma'am!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Remember, even if they are just an advance team, be extra careful. If something goes wrong, we might have a large-scale retaliation waiting for us. We need to avoid that at all costs!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Understood!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Runner, inform Patriot immediately!

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member
steps.text: Tell FrostNova right away—Ugh! Ah, *cough*...!

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: Kondrasha!!

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: You!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Hang in there, Yeti!

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member
steps.text: Aghh!!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: What...? What just happened?! Quick! S-Set him down here! Take that goddamned spear out!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: (...What's going on? The black spear... grew out of his body?!)

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: (No, it can't be... The Empire's monsters?! What are they doing here?!)
*Hiss*...

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: Ngh, ugh... Ungh!

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: What? Think you're all that?!

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: I'll show you what for! Let's go! Get him!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Stop...!

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: What are you doing? Why are you stopping me?!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: You have no idea... You have no idea what you're facing! You don't even know what exactly he is, and you want to get yourself killed?!
*Hiss*...

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: What are you so freaked out for?! We've got this many people on our side!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: (Smashes shield into the ground)

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: Ugh?!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Do you want to get yourself killed?!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: ...That's...

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: That's the goddamned Ursus Royal Guard!

steps.name: Royal Guard?
steps.text: ...To think the Shieldguards have fallen this low.

steps.name: Royal Guard?
steps.text: Take my advice. Kill yourselves now.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: All Shieldguards, back in formation! Protect the other soldiers!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Remember! Don't give him any openings!

steps.name: Royal Guard?
steps.text: *Hiss*...

steps.name: Royal Guard?
steps.text: There is fear abound in the air.

steps.name: Royal Guard?
steps.text: The Infected next to you isn't ready at all.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Don't be afraid! The more afraid you are, the more likely he will kill you!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: He may attack at any moment! Eyes open! Don't take your eyes off of him for even one second!

steps.name: Royal Guard?
steps.text: Looks like I'm leaving empty-handed again. These three cities need to be cut off from the information net for being completely useless.

steps.name: Royal Guard?
steps.text: Infected.

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: Ugh, ugh...! What are you so smug for?! You...

steps.name: Royal Guard?
steps.text: Surrender to the local garrison, or I will slice all your mouths and noses off and bringing them with me.

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: M-Mouths and noses... Isn't that...

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: ...The Liches... The Facerending Liches! I-I thought that was just a made up fairy tale...?!

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: You mean... we are looking at them right now?! The Liches that slice faces off of bodies after killing everyone, leaving behind nothing but a bunch of nameless corpses in the forest?!

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: How long have these guys been around...? I first heard the story... T-They could only be Liches!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: No, they aren't legends, and they aren't the Demons in the fairy tales! They're murderers and executioners!

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: How are we even supposed to fight Liches?! We are no match for these guys! We're just people, just normal people!

steps.name: Royal Guard?
steps.text: The Infected... called himself normal.

steps.name: Royal Guard?
steps.text: *Huff*...

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: ...You... You...

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: Help... Help me...

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Don't run away!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: All of you, stay right where you are! You'll die if you run!

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: He's not even human! How are we supposed—

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: I'll kill anyone who runs!

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Like it or not, you're now in the same boat as everyone else. If the defense line falls, everyone will die!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: They are nowhere as terrifying as you think. They're still made of flesh and blood! Not even the Royal Guards can take down the Shieldguards' layers of defense without a tough fight...

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: ...But if you're scared, you will become their breakthrough. They'll start with you when the killing starts!

steps.name: Royal Guard?
steps.text: We're both among the strongest forces in Ursus, and yet the Shieldguards choose to oppose us and stand with the Infected. How foolish.

steps.name: Royal Guard?
steps.text: These are truly unfortunate times.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: He's unsheathing his blade! Shieldguards, shields up!! Hold!

steps.name: Royal Guard?
steps.text: *Hiss*...

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: ...He... He's not attacking?

steps.name: Royal Guard?
steps.text: ...Something is burning. I can smell it.

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: Ahh... My body's starting to warm up...

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: —Could it be... she's here?!

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: She's here! She's here! Relax, everyone, she's here! Even the Liches are no match for her flames!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: ...Don't let your guard down! The Royal Guards aren't...
You wanted to bring whose what back with you now?!

steps.name: Royal Guard?
steps.text: *Huff*...
You hurt my people. If you turn to violence, then we will return the favor—

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: With violence—

steps.name: Royal Guard?
steps.text: I see you.

steps.name: Royal Guard?
steps.text: 3, 7, 22, 36. 【Code words】, 【Code words】.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: ...What are the Ursus Royal Guards... doing here?!

steps.name: Royal Guard?
steps.text: *Huff*...

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Talulah... You shouldn't have come. You should've waited for the Captain...!

steps.name: Royal Guard?
steps.text: You want to know why we are here.

steps.name: Royal Guard?
steps.text: We are here because we are looking for the duke's daughter. In other words, you. We need to assess the situation.
The sound of the snow falling to the ground is crisp and clear.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: What did you just call me?

steps.name: Royal Guard?
steps.text: The duke's daughter, and bear this in mind. Given your social standing, surely there are more civilized vocabularies you could use to refer to us.

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: ...Whose daughter did you just call me?

steps.name: Royal Guard?
steps.text: You deny the truth, as you are wont to.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You think I'm the daughter of a snake?!

steps.name: Royal Guard?
steps.text: Anger... and it stems from your irritation... You want to run away from the truth.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: The 'Emperors' Blade'...? *Spit*! You came all the way here today to mock me? Or are you here to kill me?!

steps.name: Royal Guard?
steps.text: *Hiss*.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: —Protect Talulah!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: (My brothers! The Royal Guards may be fierce, but there's only one of them! We have Talulah leading the charge, and we'll hold the line! With the rest of you supporting us, we'll definitely...)

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: (...My Infected brothers?)

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: (The duke's daughter? What is he talking about?)

steps.name: 'Emperors' Blade'
steps.text: *Hiss*.

steps.name: 'Emperors' Blade'
steps.text: You didn't tell them who you really are.

steps.name: 'Emperors' Blade'
steps.text: Is this part of your plan?

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: ...Plan...? What plan?

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: How dare you mock her?!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You better watch who you are talking to before you try to provoke someone and turn people against her, executioner. My identity has nothing to do with the goal we are working toward here.

steps.name: 'Emperors' Blade'
steps.text: You can only turn one against another if there existed trust between them in the first place. I doubt there is any trust between you and the rest of them.

steps.name: 'Emperors' Blade'
steps.text: I can only surmise... You believe the trust they have for you will remain unscathed even after they come to know who you really are.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: All that coming from a masked villain that carries out covert massacres at the Ursus Empire's behest? I'm afraid no one here needs to be criticized by your kind.

steps.name: 'Emperors' Blade'
steps.text: Your words are strong... and confident.

steps.name: 'Emperors' Blade'
steps.text: If this is as you expected... Very well, I must reassess the situation.

steps.name: 'Emperors' Blade'
steps.text: I bid you goodbye, then. Remember this well. There is one thing we share with the people standing around you.

steps.name: 'Emperors' Blade'
steps.text: We have no trust in you. You must take action to earn even the tiniest trickle of trust.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Stop.

steps.name: 'Emperors' Blade'
steps.text: *Hiss*... You have a question?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You attacked my people. You know we are here.

steps.name: 'Emperors' Blade'
steps.text: Am I perhaps misunderstanding you?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Who are you trying to rat our secrets out to?

steps.name: 'Emperors' Blade'
steps.text: *Huff*...

steps.name: 'Emperors' Blade'
steps.text: Which secret?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Soldiers, we can't let him give away our location!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: (Talulah, are you confident... you can defeat a Royal Guard?)

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: (If we don't do this, we'll face even more losses down the line... We'll have the Patrol Unit and even the Ursus army hunting us down day and night!)

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: (It takes the Royal Guards time to respond to our actions.)

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: (Only if we bring the enemy in front of us under control now will we have the choice between retreating or pressing forward later. If we want to be able to pick, we have to act now!)

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Besides, while we may need to raise our guards against him, we have no reason to fear him. He represents fear, but fear doesn't stand a chance against our anger for our unjust treatment.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: —She's right. The guerrillas have no reason to fear the empire's murderers.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: How can we still call ourselves the Aegis of the Infected if we just tremble in fear? A lone man is no match for all of us, united! He's just a lone executioner, nothing more!

steps.name: 'Emperors' Blade'
steps.text: You are mistaken about one thing... I am not here alone.

steps.name: 'Emperors' Blade'
steps.text: There is one more of us behind you.
A figure wearing a large overcoat stands solemnly on the path Talulah just took.
Each and every flake of white snow, falling from the gray sky up above, abruptly turns black as it lands on his coat, before disintegrating and scattering across the ground as ashes.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: There's two of them...?

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: So what? Just the two of you trying to cut off the dozens of us? Ridiculous!

steps.name: 'Emperors' Blade'
steps.text: Daughter of Kashchey, allow me to postulate that you've come to the following conclusion: Your peers will not be suspicious of you merely because of your identity.

steps.name: 'Emperors' Blade'
steps.text: Then let us verify the results. If your judgment proves incorrect, then the promise your father made to us shall be considered void.

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: What is he talking about...?

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: What are you people daydreaming about?!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Snap out of it! They're not just after Talulah!

steps.name: Infected
steps.text: ...What?!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Do you think these murderers will just let the rest of us go once she's dead?

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Protect Talulah!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: No... Protect the soldiers!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: First, push them back! After that, secure a way out! Finally, protect yourselves!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Don't think too hard about it all right now! Just do everything you can to stay alive!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: After all... there is nothing we can do if we aren't alive. If they kill us here, it'll all be over!

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Live!

steps.name: 'Emperors' Blade'
steps.text: What you said could not be more different than how your father would see it.

steps.name: 'Emperors' Blade'
steps.text: ...I am afraid you may only prove to be a disappointment, leader of the Northern Tundra Infected.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I'm not a leader.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I am just... an Infected. I have no reason to impress you.
